opening_analysis.diagnosis: The opening is a dry catalog of units. No hook, no problem statement, no reason to read further. The thesis (that these units form a unified framework) is stated but not motivated. The reader has no sense of why this matters or what gap it fills.

logical_gaps: No explicit connection between DT-000 (math before matter) and DT-001 (math is moral) — the leap from ontology to morality is asserted but not argued.
The transition from foundation layer (DT-000–002) to pathology layer (DT-003–004) is not explained.
unresolved_tensions: The Master Equation is referenced but never defined or explained in this document.
The claim that mathematics is 'intrinsically moral' is presented as a breakthrough but not supported here.

redundant_passages: The 'How Units Connect' section largely repeats the ordering already implied by the unit list.
The quick links at the bottom duplicate links already present in the unit descriptions.
flow.suggested_reorder: Move 'How Units Connect' immediately after the unit descriptions and before the completion status table. Move supporting resources to an appendix or separate page.
